title: Brand Safety
description: At >x<, our mission is to serve the public conversation while ensuring a safe and trusted environment where users and brands can participate freely, confidently, and securely. We are continuously improving our policies, products, and partnerships to keep our community safe. We are proud to say that >x< is safer today than ever before. Before any campaign goes live, we have layers of protections in place to ensure Safety for our users and Brand Safety for our Advertisers.

runs: We empower our users to shape their own experiences on the platform, giving them tools to decide what kind of content they want to see. Similarly, we provide brands with robust controls to determine where their ads appear — allowing them to engage in the conversations that align with their values while avoiding those that don’t.

For users, we maintain openness about our safety philosophy, policies, and enforcement through regular transparency reports. For brands, we offer unmatched visibility into where ads appear and what content they are adjacent to, supported by post-bid reporting through our verification partners.
Together, these values define our commitment to fostering both safety and expression on the platform.
For more details about our Safety team’s philosophy, please visit the >x< Rules or follow @Safety on >x<.

At >x<, brand safety is foundational to how we build, operate, and evolve our platform. Our approach is grounded in a combination of advanced technology, clear policies, strong partnerships, and advertiser controls, all working together to create a safe and suitable environment for brands to connect with their audiences.

We take a multi-layered approach that integrates machine learning and human review to proactively assess content and enforce our policies at scale. Our systems are designed to evaluate content contextually in real time, helping ensure ads are delivered alongside content that meets our brand safety and suitability standards.

Transparency and independent validation are core to our philosophy. We partner with industry-leading third parties, including Integral Ad Science and DoubleVerify, to provide advertisers with trusted, independent measurement of ad adjacency and campaign performance. These solutions align with industry-standard frameworks and offer additional confidence in where and how ads appear on >x<.

Our investments continue to deliver strong results. In 2025, >x< achieved average scores of 99.99% for brand safety and 97% for brand suitability across third-party measurement partners, reflecting performance that meets or exceeds industry benchmarks.

We also provide advertisers with a comprehensive suite of controls to customize their experience, including adjacency controls, placement controls, sensitivity settings, and keyword targeting. These tools allow brands to tailor campaign delivery based on their unique standards and objectives.

Beyond technology and controls, our policies and platform-level protections are designed to support a healthier, safer environment for everyone on >x<. From content moderation and enforcement to features that give people more control over conversations, we are continuously investing in the long-term integrity of the platform.
Brand safety is an ongoing commitment. We will continue to innovate, partner, and evolve our approach to meet the needs of advertisers and the expectations of the broader ecosystem.
